unit.why: A brief anecdote: in the winter before his death (1872) the rebbe said things nobody understood, and after his passing they were recognized as a testament guiding what to do.
unit.boundary_note: Reads as a summary heading; the specific sayings may be told in the following divisions (כט ff.).

stories.start_quote: בחורף דשנת תרל״ב אשר בקיץ שלאחריו
stories.summary_en: In the winter of 1872, before his death that summer, the tzaddik said things nobody understood; after his death they were recognized as a testament on every matter, without which his followers would not have known how to act.

tags.why: His words were understood only after his death.

quotes: כי הכל הי' כעין צוואה בכל ענין וענין
tags.why: His words foresaw the needs that arose after his death.
Framed around his last months and the testament he left.
The tzaddik's death is the pivot of the story.

quotes: מה שאח״כ הוצרכו מאד אלה הדיבורים
tags.why: Implied foreknowledge of what would be needed.
